integrity: All statements supported by an explicit signed-matrix proof and a standalone exact-rational diagnostic; numeric finite tests are not used as infinite proofs. Source claims and bibliographic priority remain subject to independent verification.
scientific_limitations: The exact law counts nontrivial fixed points of iterates, including smaller prime periods. It treats dimension two only; the folded-normal limit is weak convergence, not total-variation convergence. No independent validation has been performed.
title: Binomial multiplier anisotropy and folded-normal fluctuations in the planar twisted baker map
